memory.memory_high_behavior: capture exact sandbox value and require it unchanged
memory.swap_behavior: require a stable finite cgroup bound or zero host swap

cpu.allocation: first two CPUs in cpuset.cpus.effective, feature replay on first and graph ranking on second

storage.required_relation: same backing device and distinct immutable inodes
storage.cache_start: POSIX_FADV_DONTNEED on each workload's own event or edge segment input
